note: Both sets capture the main dimensions and title-block data, but Set A includes clearer misbindings and inventions: 'SK' expanded to 'skirting' (the detail is the island section thru sink), 'MWK04 | component | QZ' (QZ is a countertop material, not a component), and an unsupported 'base height 8"' binding. Set B is better grounded overall, adding correctly bound metadata (team name, client, BOREALIS project name, copyright, revision 1 description) and the well-supported MWK04+MWK05 combined width of 6'-7 1/2", though it repeats the same 'MWK04 | component | QZ' error, double-binds 7'-0 1/8" to both MDF GABLE and MWB02, and carries several trivial label claims (GT, P3, MWB02). Both share the unsupported 'dimension B' condition on the 3'-0" kitchen height and the ambiguous 5" thickness/backsplash reading.
